_about: Structured extract of the quiz definitions Keeps serves in public JavaScript (build P4aieEbp7XXsoIDdfc_hQ, read 2026-11-23). Answers are [label shown | subtitle, value stored in sessionStorage]. Raw copies: quiz-definition.js and quiz-definition.legacy-mini-quiz.js.

mainQuiz.storage: Each answer is saved in sessionStorage under its name as a JSON array, e.g. priority = ["Balanced Results"]. A skip link saves "Not Sure".

mainQuiz.navigation: After each answer the next step is step+1, skipping any step whose hideIf matches (op 'notEquals': hidden when the stored value differs from 'value'). The URL carries ?step=N.

pseudoCode: if t == 'Topical Prescription': return DROP_THREE_MONTH (18635) if p == 'Simple & Affordable' else DROP_PLUS_THREE_MONTH (18636)
else: return FIN_CHEW_THREE_MONTH (18640) if p == 'Simple & Affordable' else CHEW_PLUS_THREE_MONTH (19277)
recommendation.then: Browser goes to /hair-treatment-plan?productId=<id>. No answers are sent to a server before that page.

gelQuiz.steps: Same list as mainQuiz built with isGelFunnel=true: the treatmentType step is left out and the phone step is never included.

rules.special: where includes patchy -> askDr: no products, browser sent to the request-a-consultation flow. Otherwise the product ids are joined into /quiz/lead?products=...
rules.ruleSetChoice: The 'LBS' rule set is used only when the utm campaign contains 'lb' (and not 'sb') and the source is not facebook; otherwise the default ('SBS') rule set.
